items.textToSpeech: Based on data from the United States Department of Agriculture, the highest food source of petunidin by weight is raw blueberries, which contain as much as 111 milligrams of petunidin per 100 grams. Additionally, the following foods contain as much as 15 milligrams of petunidin or more per 100 grams. Raw bilberry, frozen unsweetened blueberries, raw rabbiteye blueberries, raw wild blueberries, raw cocoplum, raw jambolan, raw mature black beans, and raw mature black cowpeas. Is there anything else I can help you with?
